bigOptions.runtime: Not Ollama: a llama.cpp or vLLM build with Kimi K3 support; Moonshot suggests ~64 accelerators to serve.
bigOptions.note: Custom "Kimi K3 License": open-weight, not open source (resale / revenue-share terms), so a pointer only — weights are never republished here. No abliterated build exists yet. The smallest quant (466 GB) nominally fits a 512 GB M3 Ultra but leaves too little for macOS and a real 1M-token context; the intended home is the owner's planned NVIDIA DGX Spark + M5 Studio rig. Weights released 2026-07-27.
